title: ELKS 0.9.2 (Embeddable Linux Kernel Subset)
notes: Official v0.9.2 release floppy, run unmodified. Needs a PC/AT BIOS ROM (pass romBytes) plus the at-floppy-drive-type quirk: ELKS reads the floppy drive type from INT 13h AH=08h BL, which a bare XT BIOS never sets. Run via bw-board runI8086FloppyBundle; verified by scripts/elks-media-proof.mjs. GPL-2 kernel; fetched, never re-hosted.
